001package io.github.ai4ci.config.setup;
002
003import org.immutables.value.Value;
004import org.jgrapht.generate.GnpRandomGraphGenerator;
005import org.jgrapht.graph.DefaultEdge;
006import org.jgrapht.graph.SimpleGraph;
007
008import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeInfo;
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonTypeName;
010import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonDeserialize;
011import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.annotation.JsonSerialize;
012
013import io.github.ai4ci.abm.Person;
014
015/**
016 * Erdos‑Reyni (G(n,p)) network configuration.
017 *
018 * <p>
019 * Provides parameters used to generate a random graph under the G(n,p) model.
020 * The graph generator is used during the {@code setupOutbreak} stage by the
021 * model builder to populate the social network graph.
022 *
023 * @author Rob Challen
024 */
025@Value.Immutable
026@JsonSerialize(as = ImmutableErdosReyniConfiguration.class)
027@JsonDeserialize(as = ImmutableErdosReyniConfiguration.class)
028@JsonTypeInfo(use = JsonTypeInfo.Id.NAME)
029@JsonTypeName("erdos-reyni")
030public interface ErdosReyniConfiguration extends NetworkConfiguration {
031
032        /**
033         * Default Erdos‑Reyni configuration used in examples and tests.
034         *
035         * <p>
036         * The default supplies a simple parameterisation of the G(n,p) model with
037         * 16,384 nodes and an average degree of 100. This is a compact baseline for
038         * examples and tests that require a non‑trivial network.
039         */
040        ImmutableErdosReyniConfiguration DEFAULT = ImmutableErdosReyniConfiguration
041                .builder()
042                .setDescription(
043                        "A 128x128 Erdos-Reyni network with 100 contacts per node."
044                )
045                .setNetworkSize(128 * 128)
046                .setNetworkDegree(100)
047                .build();
048
049        /**
050         * Populate the supplied social network graph using the stored parameters.
051         *
052         * @param socialNetwork a mutable JGraphT graph to populate
053         */
054        @Override
055        default void generateGraph(SimpleGraph<Person, DefaultEdge> socialNetwork) {
056                var gen = new GnpRandomGraphGenerator<Person, DefaultEdge>(
057                                this.getNetworkSize(),
058                                ((double) this.getNetworkDegree() + 1.0) / this.getNetworkSize()
059                );
060                gen.generateGraph(socialNetwork);
061        }
062}
